3 contributions

khap khap
Aug 2026 • Friends
I just had the opportunity to visit Khap Khap and feel generally that this is a restaurant quite worth trying if you want to find a good place to eat and comfortable space.

My favorite thing is that the food is tasty, beautifully presented and ready quite quickly. The dishes have a harmonious taste, fresh ingredients, eaten orally. The price is also reasonable compared to the price.

In terms of space, the restaurant is decorated in a youthful style, clean, beautiful light should be quite suitable to go with friends or take photos. The dinner room was busy but not too noisy.

The staff is friendly, enthusiastic and supports guests quite quickly. This is a plus because the eating experience becomes more enjoyable.

Prices are on average, not too cheap but proportional to the quality of the dish and space. If you go in a group, there will be more choices and it is reasonable to split up.

Written January 1, 2026
Khap Khap Thai Bistro
Dear Ms. Monika,

Thank you for visiting Khap Khap and sharing your feedback. We are delighted to hear that you found our dishes tasty.

Regarding the portion sizes, we would like to share that our dishes are typically designed for sharing among 2-3 people, allowing guests the opportunity to experience a wider variety of flavors. Furthermore, our pricing reflects the complete experience we strive to provide, from carefully selected quality ingredients to our unique atmosphere and dedicated service. We always aim to balance these elements to deliver the best value to our guests.

We truly regret that the portions did not meet your expectations on this occasion. We have taken note of your comments and will ensure our staff is more attentive in suggesting additional dishes or portion sizes that better suit our guests' appetites at the time of ordering.

We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back for a more satisfying and complete dining experience in the future.

Warm regards,

Best Massaman curry
Aug 2025 • Family
After more than 20 years of traveling through Southeast Asia, I never expected to find the very best Massaman curry of my life here in Saigon — but this Thai restaurant delivered exactly that. Every detail makes the experience special: the food is not only delicious but deeply memorable, the prices are fair, and the atmosphere is refined yet soothing. The outdoor patio feels like a hidden oasis, with soft music and tasteful décor that invite you to linger.
The kindness and attentiveness of the staff, who make you feel welcome from the first moment, completes the experience. This is the kind of place you want to return to again and again.
